description: Source code for an image generation tool, including schema definitions, provider resolution, input validation, media loading, and tool creation logic.

methods.name: getImageGenerationProviderAuthEnvVars

methods.description: Resolves a list of candidate models for image generation based on configuration and defaults.

methods.name: resolveImageGenerationModelConfigForTool
methods.description: Resolves the model configuration for the image generation tool, considering explicit config and defaults.

methods.name: resolveAction
methods.description: Determines whether the action is 'generate' or 'list' based on input arguments.

methods.name: resolveRequestedCount
methods.description: Validates and returns the number of images requested, within allowed bounds.

methods.description: Normalizes resolution string to supported values (1K, 2K, 4K).

methods.name: normalizeAspectRatio
methods.description: Validates and normalizes aspect ratio string.

methods.name: normalizeReferenceImages

methods.name: resolveSelectedImageGenerationProvider

methods.name: loadReferenceImages
